vulcan: A rotary mech gatling gun firing one short burst, rapid mechanical thumps, 1990s anime robot sound effect
rocket: A small missile launching from a shoulder pod: a sharp whoosh with a fizzy rocket trail
laser: A powerful sci-fi laser beam firing: a bright electric zap with a rising whine, retro anime style
mortar: A heavy plasma mortar launching: a deep hollow thoomp with an electric hum
boom: A punchy explosion that shatters into a shower of small glassy crystal cubes tinkling down
bigboom: A huge explosion of a giant crystal monster: a deep boom then a long cascade of thousands of glass cubes clattering down
shatter: A small crystal creature shattering into tiny glass cubes: a bright crunchy tinkle
crumble: A block of rock breaking apart into chunky stone cubes: a crunchy crumble
pickup: A tiny bright magical blip chime, collecting a small gem
levelup: A sparkling 1990s anime power-up sound: rising chimes and a synth shimmer
overdrive: A dramatic 1990s anime mecha power surge: a rising electric charge, a roaring engine and a heroic synth swell
hurt: A heavy metal clang of a robot taking a hit, with a short electric crackle
shield: An energy shield absorbing a hit: a resonant electric pulse
stomp: A giant robot foot slamming the ground: a heavy thud and a rumble
step: A single heavy mechanical robot footstep with a short servo whir
rescue: A metal cage unlocking with a heavy clunk, followed by a short happy chime
roar: A giant monster roar made of grinding glass and electric distortion, a kaiju bellow
alarm: A sci-fi warning alarm: a two-tone klaxon blaring twice
click: A short crisp user interface button click, retro electronic
open: A quick sci-fi user interface panel sliding open with a soft whoosh
buy: An electronic purchase confirmation chime with a mechanical ratchet click
gift: A cute wrapped present being opened: a paper rustle and a gentle sparkle chime
clear: A short triumphant 1990s anime victory jingle: brass and electric guitar
fail: A short sad defeat jingle: descending synth notes with a power-down whine
spit: A wet alien goo projectile spat out with a squelch
hatch: A crystalline egg cracking open with a squelchy pop
